description: Import a DICOM folder into a BIDS dataset with BIDSvue's import pipeline, without a window: dcm2niix (or another importer), BIDSvue's post-pass cleanup, then the dataset under the step's output directory. Same output and handoff as the interactive bidsvue tool, with settings taken from the inputs instead of the user.

subject.description: BIDS subject label (default: from the DICOM PatientID).

anonymize.description: Also strip dates from the sidecars (dcm2niix -ba y).

block.label: Ingest with BIDSvue (no window)
block.description: Import DICOMs into BIDS with BIDSvue's pipeline and fixed settings.

requirements: BIDSvue checkout (bidsui, branch neuroflow/window-ingest until niivue/BIDSvue#18 merges, then main) beside NeuroFlow or via NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_BIDSVUE, with `bun install` run in it
dcm2niix for BIDSvue: its staged sidecar, DCM2NIIX, or PATH
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs `bun run scripts/neuroflow-ingest.ts --neuroflow-session $NEUROFLOW_SESSION` in the BIDSvue checkout, after `--check` confirms it is ready, which imports inputs.dicom_dir into $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/bids and writes neuroflow.handoff.json and its provenance line.

probe.advice: run `bun install` in the BIDSvue checkout and stage its dcm2niix sidecar, or set DCM2NIIX
